content:
Following Riccardo's message, I have opened #43242, which marks Rat.castHom as instance_reducible. If I am not mistaken, Nat.castRingHom and Int.castRingHom were given the same attribute in #38451, in order to remove analogous diamonds.

With this attribute, the Algebra ℚ structure coming from DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra seems to agree with the algebra structure already there. For an intermediate field S of characteristic zero, S.algebra' = DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra is provable by with_implicit rfl, that was not the case before. A similar results is true for QuadraticAlgebra ℚ a b after a small change in the construction of the algebra structure.

It was noted in #38451 that this kind of change has no noticeable performance impact and the benchmark of #43242 does not report anything significant. There is only one proof in the library that needed repair in Mathlib/FieldTheory/PrimeField.lean.

I am not sure whether the rational case was left out on purpose or whether it simply did not come up. Any comment would be welcome, in particular if there is a reason not to do this.
